about: FR-11 interior parity references (BB1, BB6, BB7, BB8), generated by scripts/parity/gen_pyvinecopulib_bb.py - do not edit by hand. Floats are shortest round-trip repr of IEEE-754 doubles; null = not recorded.

definitions.pars: reference-agnostic key (README): [theta, delta] of the unrotated family (Joe 1997, ch. 5), positive for every rotation; native = the Bicop call (convention_checks.parameter_order)
definitions.h1: hfunc1 = P(U2 <= v | U1 = u) = dC/du
definitions.h2: hfunc2 = P(U1 <= u | U2 = v) = dC/dv
definitions.hinv1: hinv1: the y with h1(u, y) = v (inverse in the second argument)
definitions.hinv2: hinv2: the x with h2(x, v) = u (inverse in the first argument)
definitions.tau: Bicop.tau (sign flipped by the reference for 90/270)

convention_checks.judged_on: median over the points (max recorded); param_* absolute against the textbook CDF; pdf errors relative above pdf = 1, absolute below
